title: Database becomes the single source of truth for agents and plugins
description: Remove @settings/ as a source of truth so agents and plugins are read and written exclusively through the database.

tasks.title: Clean dead model settings code
tasks.description: Remove leftover code that references @settings/models/ (already deleted from disk): readModelsFile, modelsFile path resolution, broken imports in tests, and stale schema generation.
acceptanceCriteria: No TypeScript file imports or references readModelsFile, importModelsFromFile, or modelsFile paths.
settings-import/index.test.ts no longer imports a missing module and still passes if relevant tests remain.
generate-schema/index.ts no longer attempts to emit @settings/models/models.schema.json.
npm run typecheck passes.
requirements: SPEC-0003: Eliminate @settings/ as source of truth.
No migration of model data (database already owns models).

steps.title: Open scripts/src/settings-import/parse.ts
steps.description: Remove readModelsFile function and its imports (modelsConfigSchema, models repo).

steps.title: Open scripts/src/settings-import/paths.ts
steps.description: Remove modelsFile property from SettingsPaths and any fallback resolution for models.jsonc.
steps.expectedResult: SettingsPaths has only agentsFile and pluginsFile (or none if those are removed in later tasks).

steps.title: Open scripts/src/settings-import/index.test.ts
steps.description: Delete the test file or remove importModelsFromFile references. Since models import is dead, delete the test if it only covers models import.
steps.expectedResult: No broken import of importModelsFromFile remains.

steps.title: Open scripts/src/generate-schema/index.ts
steps.description: Remove the modelsConfigSchema import and the logic that writes @settings/models/models.schema.json.
steps.expectedResult: Only agents and/or plugins schemas are generated (plugins schema generation may also be removed later).

steps.title: Run typecheck
steps.description: Ensure no compile errors from removal.

notes: Stop and escalate if removing model code exposes consumers that still need it.
Do not add new functionality; only delete or trim dead code.

tasks.title: Delete settings import/export/validation scripts
tasks.description: Remove the scripts that read from or write to @settings: settings-import, settings-export, generate-schema, and validate-agents.
acceptanceCriteria: Directories scripts/src/settings-import, scripts/src/settings-export, scripts/src/generate-schema, and scripts/src/validate-agents are deleted.
No other file imports from those directories.
npm run typecheck passes.
requirements: SPEC-0003: Remove or adapt settings:import / settings:export.
SPEC-0003: No future code depends on @settings JSONC files.

steps.title: Search for importers
steps.description: Find any workspace file that imports from scripts/src/settings-import, settings-export, generate-schema, or validate-agents.
steps.expectedResult: Only references are inside the directories to be deleted, plus root package.json scripts and docs (handled later).

steps.title: Delete script directories
steps.description: Remove the four directories from scripts/src/.

steps.title: Run typecheck
steps.description: Ensure no broken imports remain.

notes: If any remaining import is found outside these directories, that file must be updated first.

tasks.title: Remove SETTINGS_PATH from server environment
tasks.description: Remove the SETTINGS_PATH env variable from the server config schema and environment examples because nothing will read @settings anymore.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/config/src/server.ts no longer defines SETTINGS_PATH.
.env.example and .env.local no longer contain SETTINGS_PATH.
npm run typecheck passes.
requirements: SPEC-0003: No service depends on @settings path.

steps.title: Open packages/config/src/server.ts
steps.description: Remove the SETTINGS_PATH z.string().default('@settings') line.
steps.expectedResult: Server env schema no longer exposes SETTINGS_PATH.

steps.title: Open .env.example and .env.local
steps.description: Remove SETTINGS_PATH lines.

steps.title: Run typecheck
steps.description: Catch any consumer of SETTINGS_PATH.

notes: If typecheck fails because SETTINGS_PATH is consumed elsewhere, upgrade that failure to the implementing agent as a BLOCKED issue.

tasks.title: Update agents-manager runtime to not reference @settings
tasks.description: Remove the DEFAULT_AGENTS_PATH that points to @settings and stop the server runtime from passing an @settings file path to createAgentsManager.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/server/src/runtime/app-runtime.ts no longer constructs a path from SETTINGS_PATH/agents/agents.json.
packages/agents-manager/src/config/defaults.ts no longer references SETTINGS_PATH or @settings.
packages/agents-manager/src/index.ts createAgentsManager no longer requires or defaults to a filesystem path for agents.
Repository client still uses createDbRepository (DB source).
npm run typecheck passes.
requirements: SPEC-0003: Runtime reads agents from the database only.

steps.title: Open packages/agents-manager/src/config/defaults.ts
steps.description: Delete DEFAULT_AGENTS_PATH (or make it undefined/empty). If serverEnv.SETTINGS_PATH is the only reason to import serverEnv here, remove that import too.

steps.title: Open packages/agents-manager/src/index.ts
steps.description: Update createAgentsManager signature and defaults so dbPath is not defaulted to DEFAULT_AGENTS_PATH. Prefer requiring dbUrl/db repository instead of a JSON file path.
steps.expectedResult: Factory does not construct or require a JSON file path.

steps.title: Open apps/server/src/runtime/app-runtime.ts
steps.description: Remove the line that builds @settings/agents/agents.json path and passes it to createAgentsManager. Pass connection/repository options or leave as already configured by createAgentsManager internally.
steps.expectedResult: app-runtime.ts no longer builds a path under @settings.

steps.title: Clean repository/client.ts options
steps.description: If agentsFilePath or pluginsFilePath options are unused because createDbRepository ignores them, remove those option fields from the options interface.
steps.expectedResult: No dead file-path options in repository client.

steps.title: Run typecheck
steps.description: Ensure runtime still compiles.

notes: The repository already uses createDbRepository; this task is about removing the unused file-path surface, not redesigning the repository.

tasks.title: Update repository validation scripts and schema tests
tasks.description: Remove AJV validation scripts and update the schema JSON test so it no longer reads files from @settings.
acceptanceCriteria: repositories/agents-repository/package.json no longer has ajv validate scripts pointing to @settings.
repositories/agents-repository/src/schemas/__tests__/validate-json-schema.test.ts either validates against an in-repo schema or is removed if its only purpose was the generated @settings file.
npm test -- --run for the affected scope passes.
requirements: SPEC-0003: No more validation against @settings schema files.

steps.title: Open repositories/agents-repository/package.json
steps.description: Delete the scripts that run 'ajv validate -s ... -d ...' against @settings files.
steps.expectedResult: No remaining scripts reference agents.jsonc, plugins.jsonc, or @settings.

steps.title: Open agents-repository schema test
steps.description: If the test only validates the generated schema file under @settings, delete the test. If it tests a reusable schema (Zod-to-JSON conversion), keep the reusable part and remove the filesystem reader.

steps.title: Run tests for the repository scope
steps.description: Run the repository's test suite to confirm nothing breaks.

notes: Do not create a replacement validation unless required by another task.

tasks.title: Verify and document plugin runners source from database
tasks.description: Confirm services/agent-plugins reads plugin configuration from the database and generates output files to @storage/output/. Update outdated documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: No code under services/agent-plugins imports or reads files from @settings.
services/agent-plugins/AGENTS.md no longer says plugin metadata is edited in @settings or that schemas output to @settings.
If the plugin runner still uses a JSONC file as input, it is sourced from the database and not from @settings.
requirements: SPEC-0003: Plugin artifacts in @storage/output/ continue to be generated from the database.

steps.title: Search for @settings references in agent-plugins
steps.description: Look for any import, path, or docstring referencing @settings.

steps.title: Identify source of plugin configs
steps.description: Find where plugin runner reads agents/plugins definitions (DB query/repo call vs file).
steps.expectedResult: Code reads from a repository or API backed by the database.

steps.title: Update services/agent-plugins/AGENTS.md
steps.description: Replace statements that point to @settings with instructions to use the database/API as the source of truth.
steps.expectedResult: AGENTS.md no longer says @settings is the source of plugin metadata.

notes: If actual code is found reading @settings, create a separate fix task and BLOCK until the plan is updated.

tasks.title: Update project documentation
tasks.description: Update README.md and package-level AGENTS.md files to state that the database is the single source of truth. Delete documentation that describes @settings as canonical.
acceptanceCriteria: README.md no longer lists @settings as seed/backup optional source or documents pnpm settings:import/settings:export.
packages/agents-manager/src/AGENTS.md no longer says repository resolves @settings path automatically.
docs-check passes after doc changes.
requirements: SPEC-0003: Documentation reflects database as single source of truth.

steps.title: Open README.md
steps.description: Remove lines that describe @settings as optional seed/backup and the pnpm settings:import command. Replace with a brief note that the database is the source of truth.

steps.title: Open packages/agents-manager/src/AGENTS.md
steps.description: Remove or rewrite sentences that say the repository client resolves @settings path. State that it reads from the database.
steps.expectedResult: AGENTS.md is consistent with database source.

steps.title: Run docs-check
steps.description: Ensure regenerated indices and links remain valid.

notes: Keep documentation concise; do not add elaborate migration guides since no data migration is being done.

tasks.title: Clean root package.json scripts and references
tasks.description: Remove root package.json scripts that operate on @settings, and any workspace package.json that references the deleted scripts.
acceptanceCriteria: Root package.json no longer has settings:import, settings:export, generate:agents-schema, validate:agents, or validate:agents:all.
No turbo/pipeline entries depend on those scripts.
pnpm docs-check passes.
requirements: SPEC-0003: Scripts that read @settings are removed.

steps.title: Open root package.json
steps.description: Delete the five scripts that reference @settings operations.
steps.expectedResult: No settings:*, generate:agents-schema, or validate:agents scripts remain.

steps.title: Check turbo.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml
steps.description: Remove any task entries that reference the deleted scripts.
steps.expectedResult: No orchestration config references deleted scripts.

steps.title: Run docs-check
steps.description: Validate workspace metadata consistency.

notes: Do not add replacement seed/import scripts per user request (no migration).

tasks.title: Delete @settings directory
tasks.description: Remove the entire @settings folder from the workspace after all references are eliminated.
acceptanceCriteria: @settings/ directory is deleted.
No workspace file references @settings.
npm run typecheck, npm test, and pnpm docs-check pass.
requirements: SPEC-0003: @settings/ is removed from the workspace.

steps.title: Final reference search
steps.description: Confirm nothing references @settings before deletion.
steps.expectedResult: Only references are inside @settings itself (which will be deleted).

steps.title: Delete @settings directory
steps.description: Remove @settings and its contents.

steps.title: Run full validation
steps.description: Run the DoD commands.
steps.command: npm run typecheck && npm test && pnpm docs-check

notes: If any reference outside @settings remains, stop deletion and fix that reference first.

tasks.title: Final repository-wide validation
tasks.description: Run all required checks and a residual grep to prove no @settings dependency remains.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run typecheck passes.
npm test passes (all suites).
pnpm docs-check passes.
Final grep for '@settings' excluding version-control artifacts returns nothing.
notes: This is a validation task; no code changes unless fixes are needed to make the checks pass.

tasks.title: Mark spec as implemented and record evidence
tasks.description: Update docs/specs/0003-db-single-source-of-truth-spec.md status to implemented, fill implemented-by with impacted paths, and add any new gotchas to AGENTS.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Spec status changed from draft to implemented.
implemented-by section lists the key paths changed/deleted.
Verification section contains the commands run and their results.
New gotchas recorded in root AGENTS.md if any surfaced during the work.

steps.title: Open docs/specs/0003-db-single-source-of-truth-spec.md
steps.description: Change status to implemented and fill implemented-by with paths from the task reports.

steps.title: Document verification evidence
steps.description: Fill the Verification section with command outputs from Task-D-0001.

steps.title: Record gotchas
steps.description: If any non-obvious behavior was found (e.g. repository client ignoring file path already used DB), add a concise note to root AGENTS.md.
steps.expectedResult: Root AGENTS.md updated or unchanged if no gotchas.

notes: Do not mark implemented until Task-D-0001 is green.
